06 / FAQ

Good
questions.

How much does a website cost?+

Landing pages start at $500; corporate websites and stores at $1,000. These are starting prices. The final quote depends on scope and is agreed after the brief.

How long does it take?+

A landing page typically starts at 14 days; a complex website takes 1–2 months. Timing depends on scope and content readiness.

Can I order design only?+

Yes. Prototypes, interface design and design systems are available separately.

Do you work with existing designs?+

Yes. I build responsive websites from existing designs after checking their completeness.

How does payment work?+

The usual structure is 50% upfront and 50% after development, before launch. Terms are agreed before work starts.

What about hosting and support?+

I help with the domain, hosting and launch, and hand over the source. Support scope and third-party service costs are agreed separately.
